integrity: The finite law is proved by a uniform interleaving bijection and checked by exact exhaustive enumeration; the originality conclusion is limited to the inspected literature and does not claim novelty for classical Dirichlet-multinomial theory.
scientific_limitations: Requires exchangeable calibration-plus-future scores and almost-sure absence of ties after conditioning on the proper-training information.
Does not cover covariate shift, weighted exchangeability, adaptive score changes using future labels, or nonexchangeable time-series settings.
An equivalent formulation may exist in older multivariate tolerance-region or order-statistics literature under different terminology.
title: Uniform-composition law for multilevel split-conformal batch coverage
